description: Family-disjoint holdout for mountain cableway operations.

units.title: Haul rope
units.text: The moving steel rope that transfers traction from the drive machinery to the carriers and pulls them along the line between stations.

units.title: High-wind shutdown
units.text: Passenger service is suspended when the sustained wind threshold is exceeded because carrier swing can reduce clearance at towers and station entrances.

units.title: Line evacuation command
units.text: The operations supervisor authorizes a line evacuation after confirming that normal recovery cannot return the carriers to a station. Rescue teams deploy only after that authorization.

units.title: Detachable grip inspection
units.text: A grip that fails the measured closing-force test is removed from service and cannot return until maintenance corrects the defect and a repeat test passes.

units.title: Morning de-icing run
units.text: Before passengers board after overnight icing, an empty inspection run checks sheaves, grips and station equipment for ice accumulation.
